_about: Which forecast guidance drives the primary StormSense fore72 product. mode 'adaptive' takes each station's pick per lead band (0-12, 12-36, 36-72 h) from the StormSense Ensemble's skill scoring (https://derekloftis.github.io/StormSense-ensemble/skill/pick.json); the pick stays on P-ETSS until a week of verified runs exists, and P-ETSS is used whenever the pick is unavailable or more than 18 hours old. mode 'override' uses the named source ('petss') at every station.
